normalized_cause: Bump the contract version for the required field
evidence_summary: When `care_team_ref` becomes required while `CONTRACT_VERSION` remains `"3"`, consumers pinned to version 3 are not notified that the accepted shape has changed and may continue omitting this field. Bump `CONTRACT_VERSION` with this change, or keep the field optional, so version-gated consumers can reject or adopt the new contract explicitly.
